# Let's parse the content of the first note to understand the structure
import re

def parse_note(note):
    # Extract date from title
    date_match = re.search(r'for (\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})', note['title'])
    date = date_match.group(1) if date_match else None
    # Parse content lines
    habits = {}
    for line in note['content'].split('\n'):
        line = line.strip()
        if ':' in line and not line.startswith('#'):
            key, value = line.split(':', 1)
            habits[key.strip()] = value.strip()
    return date, habits

date, habits = parse_note(all_note_contents[0])
